## Invariants

- [ ] Entire-scene determinism preserved; no runtime randomness or image API.
- [ ] Relevant negative/error paths tested; no fixture weakening.
- [ ] Version compatibility and visible-output changes explained.
- [ ] No private-key/checkpoint collection, data exfiltration or sibling runtime changes.
- [ ] State accurately distinguishes proposed, implemented, reviewed, merged and deployed.

## Merge gate

All applicable checks executed successfully on the exact head; substantive review complete; no unresolved findings; no protection bypass or self-approval. A pending review is not a clean review. Record unavailable enforcement instead of pretending it exists.
